name: memory
description: Durable project notes, recall, and lifecycle reminders.

scan_root.title: Additional project root
scan_root.description: Optional parent folder for cheap cross-project NOTES scans (memory/ and docs/ only), not source-code indexing. Leave empty for current-project-only recall.

scan_root_2.title: Second additional project root
scan_root_2.description: Optional parent folder for cheap cross-project NOTES scans (memory/ and docs/ only), not source-code indexing. Leave empty for current-project-only recall.

index_chats.title: Index past Claude Code chats
index_chats.description: Off by default. When on, memory also serves a search_chats tool over this machine's Claude Code session transcripts (user and assistant text only), extracted into the plugin's data folder and kept current while a session runs.
